name.ja: Hamilton系・振動子

note.en: Canonical equations and a representative separable Hamiltonian. Harmonic and quartic oscillators distinguish energy error from symplecticity.

name.ja: スカラーItô拡散：GBMとOU
name.en: Scalar Ito diffusion: GBM and OU

note.ja: 決定論的初期値のスカラーSDE。平均・二次モーメントの弱誤差、共有Brown運動での強誤差、有限標本のMCSEを分けます。OUは調和Langevin系の浴成分に関連する追加検査です。
note.en: Scalar SDEs with deterministic initial states. Separate weak moment bias,strong errors on shared Brownian paths and finite-sample MCSE. OU is a related bath-component check,not the full harmonic Langevin system.

name.ja: 2モードの決定論的温度浴

note.en: This authored splitting is not a full LAMMPS/MKT reproduction. Time20does not prove mixing/equilibration; correct mean temperature alone does not establish canonical sampling or general ergodicity.

note.en: Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

name.ja: 固定線形拘束の正準運動量
name.en: Canonical momentum under fixed linear constraints

note.ja: 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
note.en: These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

name.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴

caption.ja: 電子角と核座標を実際に結合した2準位模型を、短いNVEと核熱浴で比較します。 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。
caption.en: Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath. Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

note.ja: 解析BO力とCP型作用の式をVerlet/BAOABで積分し、核熱と架空電子運動エネルギーを分けます。
note.en: Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.

caption.en: Separate effectiveDOF,momentum covariance,transient distributions and time correlations. These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

note.ja: 質量重み付き接空間でLangevin/CSVRをOBABO分割します。初期正準共分散からの有限時刻写像・雑音共分散を直接組み、連続参照と離散定常Lyapunov解を別に求めます。
note.en: Apply tangent-space Langevin/CSVR in OBABO form. Build finite-time maps and noise covariance from canonical initial data; compute continuous references and stationary discrete Lyapunov solutions separately.

note.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。

Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

note.ja: 座標の正規化・CDF・Uの平均/分散を1D求積、HのCDFをKの指数分布と2D座標Boltzmann密度の畳込み積分で得ます。求積公差2e−10と2e−12の差を保存し、独立棄却集団でもH分布を検査。q,p,K,Hの相関には複製間の標準誤差を併記し、刻み差と標本誤差を混同しません。
note.en: Obtain coordinate normalizers/CDFs and U moments by 1D quadrature, and the H CDF by convolving exponential K with the 2D positional Boltzmann density. Save the difference between quadrature tolerances 2e−10 and 2e−12; a separate rejection ensemble also checks H. Report independent-replica standard errors for q,p,K,H correlations, keeping step differences distinct from sampling noise.

Compare NH1,NHC3,Berendsen and fixed-speed baths at two couplings/two steps with256canonical and128heated replicas. Dimensionless, unit masses, kBT=1, frequencies 1/1.7; Q1=2tau², Qj=tau². Two-mode initial-value problem without spatial boundaries; fixed canonical/heated ensembles. Same two-mode quartic system plus a harmonic control; short-time and finite-sample deterministic-bath comparisons.

name.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴

note.ja: 半解析解 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units. Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas. Dimensionless; masses 1/2/3 and kBT=1. Fixed linear constraints Cq=0 and CM⁻¹p=0; redundant rows are compared on the same tangent space. These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.
